data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Marlos', meaning 'Majestic, shining one'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marline usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
